app-function.description: Creates a new task in ARSHNAZ with optional due date and priority.

parameter.name: title
parameter.description: Title of the task to create.

parameter.name: dueDateTime
parameter.description: Optional due date in ISO-8601 or YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameter.name: priority
parameter.description: Optional priority: none, low, medium, high, urgent.

app-function.description: Lists active tasks scheduled for today in ARSHNAZ (up to 20).

parameter.name: limit
parameter.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (1-20, default 20).

app-function.description: Searches active tasks in ARSHNAZ by title keyword (up to 20).

parameter.name: query
parameter.description: Keyword to search within task titles.

parameter.name: limit
parameter.description: Maximum number of tasks to return (1-20, default 20).

app-function.description: Updates an existing task's title, due date, or priority in ARSHNAZ.

parameter.name: taskId
parameter.description: Unique ID of the task to update.

parameter.name: dueDateTime
parameter.description: New due date in ISO-8601 or YYYY-MM-DD format.

parameter.name: priority
parameter.description: New priority: none, low, medium, high, urgent.

app-function.description: Marks an existing task in ARSHNAZ as completed or reopens it.

parameter.name: completed
parameter.description: True to mark task as completed; false to reopen.
